I completed all tasks using only `$MRW`.

Notes on unclear/wrong instructions (under 150 words):
- The plan format for `body=`/`anchor=`/`lines=` keys isn't specified as header-line-only vs. own-line. Putting `body=1` on its own line (as the instructions' phrasing suggested) was NOT parsed as metadata — it was treated as literal body content, silently corrupting `docs/meta.yaml` (wrote 2 lines instead of 1). Had to fix with an extra `delete` plan. This should have been documented explicitly with a syntax example.
- `--exclude GLOB` semantics ("root-relative path or basename") are ambiguous about whether `*` crosses `/`; empirically `vendor/*` and `build/*` did exclude nested files, but this wasn't guaranteed by the wording.
- Task 4 asks for "the TODO plus the one line after," but `--context`/`-C` only offers symmetric before+after context, not after-only.
- Only exit code 3 is documented; exit codes for a multi-match validation refusal (got 1) and a plan parse error (got 2, "bad line number") are undocumented.
